title: Self-Pay Purchase Terms for PAP Therapy Equipment
content:
# Self-Pay Purchase Terms — PAP Therapy Equipment

**1. Purchase.** Any class may be bought outright by a self-pay patient at the class's self-pay retail price plus the self-pay delivery fee, paid in full when the order is placed; the Travel CPAP System (E0601) is sold only this way. *The first part of this clause — the price, the delivery fee and payment when the order is placed — is no longer in force for a unit bought outright where it already stands in the patient's home on a coverage-billed device record, which is governed by the current basis; for every other outright purchase it continues to apply.*

**2. Return for a refund.** A self-pay PAP Therapy Equipment device is returned for a refund only when it comes back complete in its original packaging no later than the class's return window in days after the device is delivered, counting calendar days from the day after the delivery date with the boundary day included. The delivery date is the date the device record shows the device delivered and set up.

**3. Refund amount.** *Retired: the clause that the refund is the device price less the class's restocking percentage, rounded to the cent half up, and that the delivery fee and any mask or tubing that has been used are never refunded, is no longer in force; it has been superseded by the current basis.*

**4. Once only.** A sale is refunded at most once; whether the sale already carries a refund is read from the device's billing history, the refund naming the sale it refunds.

**5. Coverage.** A self-pay device is never billed to coverage afterward.

## Return conditions (clauses in force)

| Comes back complete in original packaging | Within the return window | Sale already refunded | Returned for a refund |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | no | yes |
| no | any | any | no |
| any | no | any | no |
| any | any | yes | no |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates)

- A Bilevel PAP Spontaneous System (E0470) with a 30-day window, delivered 10 April: day 1 is 11 April and day 30 is 10 May. Returned on 10 May — in time; on 11 May — outside the window.
- A Bilevel PAP Spontaneous-Timed System (E0471) with a 14-day window, delivered 10 April: day 14 is 24 April. Returned on 24 April — in time; on 25 April — outside.

superseded_clauses: Any class may be bought outright by a self-pay patient at `self_pay_retail_price` plus `self_pay_delivery_fee`, paid in full when the order is placed;
The refund is the device price less `self_pay_restocking_fee_pct` percent, rounded to the cent half up; the delivery fee and any mask or tubing that has been used are never refunded.
